local_repo.codegraph: not-present-at-nested-repo-root; used scoped rg and direct source reads
local_repo.dispatch_observation: No single model registry was found. Existing model dispatch is distributed across runner_wrapper.py, server/policy.py, CLI commands, latency, client, TUI, CMake, and Makefile; Wall-OSS integration must follow one explicit owner path rather than add a silent parallel registry.

source_contract_facts: requirements.txt pins torch 2.10.0, transformers 5.2.0, and torchdiffeq 0.2.5
setup.py builds an install-time CUDAExtension named wall_x.model.core.ops._cuda_ext_bin from exported CUDA sources
inference_mixin.py creates device-side torch.randn noise internally in generate_dllm_action and generate_flow_action; exporter must add an explicit external-noise seam before parity/export claims
flow inference performs an initial prefill with use_cache=True, crops every prefix KV layer to ar_prefix_length, then runs an Euler ODE loop
the model uses two token-type experts and custom permute/unpermute plus joint attention projections
the public CUDAGraph wrapper has lazy capture, batch buckets, shape guards, and naive forward fallback; production picpp must not hide fallback under a success claim
the websocket server reports server infer time separately but upstream batch policy catches exceptions into error dictionaries; picpp integration must fail-fast instead
